# SVE/SME vector-length arithmetic, baseline Advanced SIMD reversal, and
# baseline SVE/SME integer reductions. Reserved size controls stay invalid

# SME2 four-vector conversion families.  Four-vector list bases are encoded

# Exact baseline-SME predicated MOVA leaves, rendered through their preferred

# Exact SME2 MOVA transfers between ZA and aligned pairs/quads of scalable

# Exact non-saturating SVE element-count arithmetic.  Structured operands

# Exact FEAT_SVE-or-FEAT_SME conditional-termination family.  sz selects
# W/X sources, register 31 is WZR/XZR, and both leaves update NZCV.
# Exact SVE2-or-SME WHILEWR/WHILERW family.  Both leaves allocate every
# B/H/S/D and predicate/general-register payload and update condition flags.
# Exact single-predicate WHILE comparison family.  size selects B/H/S/D,
# sf independently selects W/X sources, and every form updates condition flags.
# Exact SME2/SVE2.1 paired-predicate WHILE comparison family.  Pd selects
# one of the eight even/odd predicate pairs and both sources are X registers.
# Exact SME2-or-SVE2.1 counter-predicate WHILE comparison family.  PNd

# Exact SVE-or-SME predicate-control forms. PTEST alone tests NZCV; PFIRST

# flags. PTRUE/PTRUES expose every raw pattern, including unnamed values.
# PSEL's architectural leaf exposes 32 i1:tsz controls.  The 30 typed
# controls are allocated; the two tsz=0000 controls have no assembly type.
# Complete SVE-or-SME unpredicated integer-immediate family.  The seven
# shiftable leaves reject B+LSL#8; nonzero shifted imm8 values are semantic
# immediates, while shifted zero retains its modifier to distinguish encoding.
# Exact SVE-or-SME immediate broadcasts.  Integer DUP selects its preferred
# MOV alias with a signed semantic immediate; floating FDUP selects FMOV and

# Exact unpredicated integer dot-product parent.  Baseline SVE/SME widens

# Exact SVE2-or-SME unpredicated complex/widening multiply-add groups.
# SQDML*BT widen B/H/S to H/S/D, CDOT widens B/H to S/D, and the complex

# Zm0--Zm7, S uses lanes 0--3 and Zm0--Zm7, and D uses lanes 0--1 and
# Zm0--Zm15.  Zda is destructive and both full Zda/Zn fields are allocated.

# size=10 (.S accumulator, .B sources) row of its parent is allocated.

# The U control selects USDOT/SUDOT, i2 selects lanes 0--3, Zm is restricted
# to Z0--Z7, and the accumulator/source register fields remain complete.

# carry the tied Zdn.B field; size values 01, 10, and 11 are reserved.

# FEAT_SVE2 or FEAT_SME; zeroing needs FEAT_SVE2p2 or FEAT_SME2p2.  URECPE
# and URSQRTE allocate only .S while SQABS and SQNEG allocate B/H/S/D.
# Exact SVE2-or-SME predicated pairwise widening accumulation.  Size=00 is

# Exact SVE2-or-SME destructive predicated halving arithmetic.  Every U:R:S
# control and every B/H/S/D arrangement is allocated.
# Exact destructive, merging SVE pairwise arithmetic.  SUBP requires
# FEAT_SVE2p3 or FEAT_SME2p3; the other five rows require SVE2 or SME.
# Operation controls 2 and 3 are unallocated throughout the owned parent.
# Exact SVE2-or-SME destructive, merging saturating arithmetic.  The full
# U:R:S parent and every B/H/S/D arrangement are architecturally allocated.
# Exact SVE2.1-or-SME destructive signed/unsigned clamp.  U selects the leaf;

# Exact SVE-or-SME predicate-break family.  All predicate fields use their

# Exact FEAT_SVE-or-FEAT_SME predicate unpack parent.  Bit 16 selects the
# low/high half; every Pd.H/Pn.B register-field combination is allocated.
# Exact FEAT_SVE-or-FEAT_SME signed/unsigned vector unpack parent.  Bits
# 17:16 select signed/unsigned and low/high; size=01/10/11 widen B/H/S to
# H/S/D, while size=00 is reserved for every register-field combination.
# Exact FEAT_SVE2-or-FEAT_SME unpredicated shift-insert parent.  Bit 10
# selects SRI/SLI; tszh:tszl:imm3 values 8--127 select B/H/S/D and the
# immediate, while values 0--7 are reserved for every register pair.
# Exact baseline Advanced SIMD bitwise select/insert leaves.  Q selects
# .8B/.16B; Vd is read/write while Vn and Vm are read-only.  The adjacent
# AND/BIC/ORR/ORN/EOR leaves are deliberately outside this ownership set.
# Exact FEAT_SVE_BitPerm constructive bit permutations.  opc=00/01/10
# selects BEXT/BDEP/BGRP; B/H/S/D and all three Z-register fields are fully
# allocated.  opc=11 is the sole reserved quarter of the shared parent.
# Exact baseline Advanced SIMD add/subtract high-narrow leaves.  Q=0 writes
# the low 64-bit result and uses the base mnemonic; Q=1 preserves that half,
# writes the high half, and prints the mnemonic's "2" spelling.  size=11 is
# reserved because there is no 128-bit source-element arrangement.
# Exact A64 FEAT_PAuth authenticated register branches.  Register 31 is XZR
# in the branch-target field, but SP in the explicit modifier field.  The
# link variants carry both CALL/LINK metadata and all eight leaves carry
# POINTER_AUTH.  Z=0 reserves every low Rm control other than 11111.
# Exact baseline Advanced SIMD widening add/subtract leaves.  SADDL/SSUBL

# Exact baseline Advanced SIMD signed saturating doubling widening multiply,

# Exact baseline Advanced SIMD signed saturating doubling multiply-high and
# rounding multiply-high leaves.  Q selects 64/128-bit vectors; size=01/10

# mnemonic.  size=01/10/11 remain reserved throughout the envelope.

# Q selects 64/128-bit vectors; size=00/01/10 select B/H/S elements, while

# B/H/S exist at both vector widths; destination is write-only.

# B/H/S exist at both vector widths; destination is read/write.

# destination is 4S/2D; Q selects the low/base or upper/"2" half of Vn.
# Halfword lanes use V0--V15 and H:L:M, while word lanes use V0--V31 and H:L.

# the mnemonic's "2" spelling.  H lanes use V0--V15/H:L:M while S lanes

# read/write.  Byte and doubleword size controls are unallocated.

# or upper source half and spells SHLL/SHLL2 with a fixed element-width shift.

# B/H/S/D and Q selects 64/128-bit width.  immh=0000 overlaps MOVI/MVNI;
